+"""Grace window helper."""
+from datetime import datetime
+
+STALE_GRACE_SECONDS = 48 * 3600
+
+
+def grace_elapsed_enough(now: datetime, started: datetime, grace: int = STALE_GRACE_SECONDS) -> bool:
+    return (now - started).total_seconds() >= grace

+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+from internal.r1b_perf_01 import STALE_GRACE_SECONDS, grace_elapsed_enough
+
+
+def test_grace_uses_full_wall_clock():
+    now = datetime(2026, 10, 3, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    started = now - timedelta(days=2, seconds=1)
+    assert grace_elapsed_enough(now, started) is True
+    assert STALE_GRACE_SECONDS == 48 * 3600
